data.one_liner: A data grid widget that supports keyboard control, column grouping, and editing.
data.what_it_does: PlutoGrid is a data grid component for Flutter that allows users to display, edit, sort, and navigate tabular data using both mouse and keyboard interactions. It supports specialized column types like text, numbers, select dropdowns, dates, and times.
use_when: You need a robust desktop or web data grid with heavy keyboard navigation.
You require inline cell editing, sorting, filtering, and column freezing.
avoid_when: You are looking for a standard mobile-first UI list or card layout.
You only need a simple, read-only static table without interactive features.
strengths: Excellent keyboard control support for desktop and web.
Supports multiple column types, column grouping, and server-side pagination.
Active ecosystem with related export and layout packages.
weaknesses: Mobile UI improvements are ongoing and prioritized behind desktop/web.
Large feature set can require substantial configuration for custom styling.
